content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Makes asphalt plants and aggregate and mining equipment for road builders, not railcars for rail customers."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Makes municipal street sweepers, vacuum trucks and public safety equipment, a different product set and customer base."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Makes pumps, valves and seals for process plants; repair services are aftermarket for fluid equipment, not railcars."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Makes industrial drums and containers for chemical and food makers, plus timberland; not railcar manufacturing or repair."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Diversified pumps, valves, friction and connector maker; rail is only a component supply market, not railcar building."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Trucking and intermodal freight services that move shippers' goods; it does not build, repair or refurbish railcars."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Papermaking and wood processing equipment sold to mills and sawmills; different products and customers from railcars."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Track components, friction management and precast concrete for railroads; supplies rail infrastructure, not railcars."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Designs EPA and CARB certified engines and generator sets for equipment makers; no railcar manufacturing or repair."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Industrial locks, hinges and metal castings for OEMs and distributors; not railcar design, manufacturing or service."},{"label":"C11","good":true,"reason":"Builds railcars and provides railcar maintenance, repair and refurbishment for railroads, shippers and lessors, matching the target's business."}]}
